facts.fact: Decree 8/2022 of 14 March 2022 (Council of Ministers) approves the Regulation on Standardisation and Conformity Assessment and gives the Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ, IP) the job of coordinating standardisation, implementing Mozambican Technical Standards and certifying management systems, products, services and people against them; the passages shown name no IT or data standard.

note: Body fact only; the passages name no IT, information security or data standard, and no certification actually performed.
